CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_coordinator()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.is_active_coordinator(auth.uid())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_coordinator(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p_user is not null and exists (select 1 from public.coordinators c where c.user_id = p_user and c.status = 'active')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_coordinator()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.is_coordinator(auth.uid())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_coordinator(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p_user is not null and exists (select 1 from public.coordinators c where c.user_id = p_user)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_verification(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v   verifications%ROWTYPE;
  u   users%ROWTYPE;
  fmt BOOLEAN;
  res JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Load verification submission
  SELECT * INTO v FROM verifications WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND status = 'pending';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'No pending verification found');
  END IF;

  -- Load user
  SELECT * INTO u FROM users WHERE id = p_user_id;

  -- 1. Format check
  fmt := validate_nigerian_id(v.id_type, v.id_number);
  IF NOT fmt THEN
    UPDATE verifications
    SET status = 'rejected',
        id_format_ok = false,
        auto_checked = true,
        rejection_reason = 'ID number format is invalid for the selected ID type.',
        reviewed_at = now()
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'reason', 'ID number format is invalid. Please check and resubmit.',
      'code', 'FORMAT_INVALID'
    );
  END IF;

  UPDATE verifications SET id_format_ok = true WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  -- 2. Name coherence check
  -- The first_name submitted must loosely match the name on their account.
  -- This catches people submitting someone else's NIN with their own name.
  IF v.first_name IS NOT NULL AND u.name IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT (
      LOWER(u.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(v.first_name) || '%'
      OR LOWER(u.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(v.last_name) || '%'
    ) THEN
      UPDATE verifications
      SET status = 'rejected',
          auto_checked = true,
          rejection_reason = 'Name does not match your account name.',
          reviewed_at = now()
      WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', false,
        'reason', 'The name on your ID does not match your account name. Please use the same name you registered with.',
        'code', 'NAME_MISMATCH'
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Age check — must be 18+
  IF v.dob IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(v.dob)) < 18 THEN
      UPDATE verifications
      SET status = 'rejected',
          auto_checked = true,
          rejection_reason = 'User is under 18.',
          reviewed_at = now()
      WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', false,
        'reason', 'You must be 18 or older to use StreetTasker.',
        'code', 'UNDERAGE'
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Phase 1: All soft checks passed → auto-approve ───────────
  -- When Dojah is integrated (Phase 2), this section will call
  -- the external API and only approve if the government record
  -- also matches. For now, format + name + age is sufficient
  -- to deter casual fraud.

  UPDATE verifications
  SET status = 'approved',
      auto_checked = true,
      id_format_ok = true,
      reviewed_at = now()
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  -- Mark the user as verified
  UPDATE users
  SET is_verified = true,
      verified_at = now(),
      first_name  = v.first_name,
      last_name   = v.last_name,
      dob         = v.dob
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  -- Mark their tasker profile as verified too (if they're a tasker)
  UPDATE taskers
  SET is_verified = true,
      verified_at = now()
  WHERE user_id = CAST(p_user_id AS TEXT);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'reason', 'Identity verified successfully.',
    'code', 'APPROVED'
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_nigerian_id(id_type text, id_value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  clean TEXT := UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(id_value, '\s', '', 'g'));
BEGIN
  RETURN CASE id_type
    WHEN 'nin'             THEN clean ~ '^\d{11}$'
    WHEN 'bvn'             THEN clean ~ '^\d{11}$'
    WHEN 'drivers_license' THEN clean ~ '^[A-Z]{3}[A-Z0-9]{6,9}$'
    WHEN 'passport'        THEN clean ~ '^[A-Z]{1,2}\d{7}$'
    WHEN 'voters_card'     THEN clean ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{18,19}$'
    ELSE false
  END;
END;
$function$
